description: Autothink engineering rules — code generation, refactoring, testing, network safety.
rules: Deterministic task classifier: keyword/pattern-based only (no LLM calls, no network).
Network guard: all test processes blocked from network via network_guard.py (NS_ALLOW_NETWORK=1 escapes, never in CI).
Test discipline: one change at a time, test after each edit, full pipeline verification, lint before commit.
PowerShell safety: use ; not &&, quote paths with spaces, Get-Content not cat/head/tail, Select-Object -First N for head.
No git in this repo — changes are manual; commit only after batch completion with state file update.
Audit logger: append-only JSONL (timestamp, classified track, files touched, live action requested, approval status).
